title: Change of rings preserves K-flat complexes with flat terms in independent universes
statement: Let C be a site relatively essentially small in coefficient universe r, φ:R→S a map of commutative ring sheaves and K a K-flat complex of R-module sheaves with flat terms. Let E be an additive functor with the specified changeOfRings objects and maps. Then E applied termwise to K is K-flat with flat terms over S. Site and coefficient universes are independent.

proof.text: Restriction of scalars is conservative and exact because underlying abelian sheaves and maps agree. Natural tensor cancellation identifies U(- tensor_S E(K^p)) with U(-) tensor_R K^p, proving exactness and hence flat terms. Apply cancellation in every bidegree and the additive map-total comparison to identify U Tot(F tensor_S E(K)) with Tot(UF tensor_R K), respecting both differentials and their signs. Restriction takes acyclic F to acyclic UF; K-flatness of K and reflection of acyclicity complete the proof. The object and map equations for E transport these comparisons to the specified functor.

lean.statement:
theorem changeOfRings_isKFlat_of_flat_terms_independentCoefficients
    (E : SheafOfModules.{r} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{r} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj S))
    (h : ∀ M, E.obj M = changeOfRings φ M)
    (hm : ∀ {M N} (g : M ⟶ N), E.map g =
      eqToHom (h M) ≫ changeOfRingsHom φ M g ≫ eqToHom (h N).symm)
    [E.Additive]
    (hK : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients K)
    (hflat : ∀ p : ℤ, exactFunctor _ _
      (@MonoidalCategory.tensorRight _ _ (monoidalCategory R) (K.X p))) :
    CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K) ∧
      ∀ p : ℤ, exactFunctor _ _
        (@MonoidalCategory.tensorRight _ _ (monoidalCategory S)
          (((E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K).X p))
